rationale.edition: Every changed path in the authoritative file list lives under web/src/** or scripts/translations/ (open-source frontend + its locale/translation files). None are under enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or any enterprise-gated module, and there are no enterprise keywords (SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/cipher/etc.) in the paths or symbols, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: Not skipping. There is no tests-added label or skip comment in the trigger/feature inputs, and the change is a user-facing UI change: it replaces the dashboard panel error/warning rows with a new notice-chip + tooltip system and a query inspector, so a user can exercise it.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The diff adds user-facing dashboard behavior — panel notice chips (series-cap, partial, function-error), a collapsed multi-notice chip, per-notice actions (edit function, copy error, use-top-n, refresh), and an open-inspector action that opens a QueryInspector — all of which need verification in a rendered dashboard.
rationale.area: The bulk of the UI changes live in web/src/components/dashboards/, web/src/composables/dashboard/, and web/src/utils/dashboard/, with the entry points in web/src/views/Dashboards/. Dashboards is the matching product area and the natural home for the spec.
rationale.group: Dashboards — the feature is a dashboard-panel concern and the OSS ci_matrix.json (which lives in the openobserve repo, not checked out here) groups dashboard specs under a Dashboards shard. The Engineer should confirm the existing Dashboards testfolder name in the OSS matrix before appending.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The changed test files are all Vitest unit tests (web/src/**/*.spec.ts); none are under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/, so there is no existing Playwright coverage to extend.
